"""Time-slot generation for driver assignments."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

WINDOW_OPEN = "09:00"
WINDOW_CLOSE = "17:00"

@dataclass
class Slot:
    start: str
    end: str

def _parse(t: str) -> datetime:
    return datetime.strptime(t, "%H:%M")

def _fmt(d: datetime) -> str:
    return d.strftime("%H:%M")

def build_slots(open_t: str, close_t: str, minutes: int) -> list[Slot]:
    start = _parse(open_t) + timedelta(minutes=minutes)
    end_limit = _parse(close_t)
    slots = []
    cur = start
    while cur + timedelta(minutes=minutes) < end_limit:
        slots.append(Slot(_fmt(cur), _fmt(cur + timedelta(minutes=minutes))))
        cur += timedelta(minutes=minutes)
    return slots
